channel.title: Glint Blog
channel.description: Guides and tips about Glint and AI: free API keys, Auto-pick, Townhall, privacy, study prompts and coding help. Like, save and comment.

item.title: What Is Glint? Every AI Model in One Calm Workspace
item.description: Glint is a free, private AI workspace that puts Gemini, GPT, Claude, DeepSeek and more in one place. Here is what it does and who it is for.

item.title: How to Get a Free Gemini API Key and Use It in Glint
item.description: Step-by-step: create a free Google Gemini API key in AI Studio and add it to Glint so you can chat, search the web and create images at no cost.

item.title: Groq in Glint: Blazing-Fast Free AI Answers
item.description: Learn how to add a free Groq API key to Glint and get near-instant answers from open models like Llama. Setup takes two minutes.

item.title: OpenRouter in Glint: One Key, Hundreds of Models
item.description: Use a single OpenRouter key in Glint to reach hundreds of AI models, including free ones. Here is how to set it up and when it makes sense.

item.title: Auto-Pick: How Glint Chooses the Best AI Model for Each Task
item.description: Glint's Auto-pick detects whether you are coding, researching or writing, then switches to the strongest model you have a key for.

item.title: Townhall: Make AI Models Debate Your Question
item.description: Townhall seats several AI models around a table to debate your question, then a chair writes the final answer. Learn when and how to use it.

item.title: How Glint Encrypts Your Chats So Only You Can Read Them
item.description: A plain-English guide to Glint's privacy design: encryption in your browser, ciphertext-only sync, and what happens if you forget your password.

item.title: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK): Why It Is Cheaper and Safer
item.description: What bring-your-own-key means, why it can cost less than AI subscriptions, and how Glint keeps your keys private while you use them.

item.title: 10 Study Prompts for Students to Use in Glint
item.description: Ten practical prompts that turn Glint into a patient tutor: explain simply, quiz yourself, plan revision and check your own understanding.

item.title: Debug Code Faster with AI in Glint
item.description: A practical workflow for debugging with AI: how to describe errors, what to paste, and how Glint's coding mode picks a strong model for you.

item.title: Research With Live Web Search in Glint
item.description: Turn on web search in Glint to get answers grounded in current sources instead of guesses. Learn how to ask, verify and compare viewpoints.

item.title: Write With AI Without Losing Your Voice
item.description: How writers can use AI as a thinking partner while keeping their own style: prompts for ideas, feedback and editing that still sound like you.

item.title: Compare AI Models Side by Side in Glint
item.description: Send one prompt to several AI models and compare answers in one place. Learn how to judge quality, speed and tone to find your favourite.

item.title: Extended Thinking: When to Turn It On in Glint
item.description: Extended thinking makes AI models reason longer before answering. Learn which tasks benefit, which do not, and how it affects speed.

item.title: How to Install Glint on Your Phone or Desktop
item.description: Glint is a progressive web app. Add it to your home screen on iPhone or Android, or install it in Chrome and Edge, in under a minute.

item.title: Temporary Chats: Private Conversations That Leave No Trace
item.description: Use Glint's temporary chat for sensitive questions. It is never saved or synced and disappears when you leave. Here is when to use it.

item.title: Import Your Memory From Another AI Into Glint
item.description: Moving to Glint does not mean starting over. Import what your old assistant knows about you with a simple copy-and-paste flow.

item.title: Glint Keyboard Shortcuts and Power-User Tricks
item.description: Work faster in Glint with keyboard shortcuts, quick model switching, temporary chats and a few habits that save time every day.

item.title: Create Images, Video and Music With Gemini Inside Glint
item.description: Glint is not just text. Switch modes to create images, video and music using Gemini models. Learn how, and how to write better creative prompts.

item.title: Seven Rules for Better AI Prompts That Work on Any Model
item.description: Better prompts mean better answers. These seven simple rules work with Gemini, GPT, Claude, Llama and every other model you use in Glint.

item.title: How to Fact-Check AI Answers Quickly
item.description: AI can sound sure and still be wrong. Use these quick checks, plus web search and Townhall in Glint, to verify answers before you rely on them.

item.title: Why I Built Glint: A Student's Story
item.description: I am V Yash Raj, a high school student and author. This is the story of why I built Glint and what I hope it makes easier for people like me.
